card.name: Words just before the word bottle
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'bottle', such as amber, glass, PET, or 'neck of', in compounding and packaging text. It responds to container wording where 'bottle' is the likely next word.

modes.label: Container material
modes.description: Material or color words describing a bottle, like amber or glass.
modes.example: Add 80 mL of Ora-Plus®* oral suspending vehicle to an<< amber>> glass bottle containing 8 valsartan

modes.label: Closing bracket or link before bottle
modes.description: A bracket or small linking word just before the word bottle.
modes.example: push bottle adapter into neck<< of>> bottle.

modes.label: Volume before bottles
modes.description: A unit of volume after a number in a supply statement, before bottles.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word bottle (and bottles) next.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up the next word being 'bottle', like amber, glass or the size of the bottle.
